timingPolicy.work: legacy discovery + N full action replays vs pause + N child resumes; includes forks, history remapping and common postprocessing
timingPolicy.control: Both modes run in the same experimental assembly and share extracted completion tails; not a binary A/B against unmodified shipping code.
timingPolicy.warmUp: one second of paired mode execution before every branch count; Dagger Throw also has 400 initial paired families
timingPolicy.options: same prebuilt legal choices in both modes; option preparation excluded from timing; all legal combinations checked separately
timingPolicy.isolation: shared simulation scope per measurement loop
timingPolicy.gc: ordinary GC; no forced collection inside timing
timingPolicy.elapsedMeasure: wall time per family; summary uses all four samples and reports median plus min/max

retentionPolicy.additionalHeldState: one legacy pending state or one checkpoint per family
retentionPolicy.measure: GC.GetTotalMemory(true) after - before; all held objects kept alive through collection
retentionPolicy.measureScope: controlled managed live held-state high-water mark; not process RSS or full search peak
